purpose: Customer-relevant final benchmark; v7 weights frozen; no new fitting or selective deletion
status: Exploratory reused evaluation streams. No actual fab cost or yield measured.
phases: Every offset for each period; all offsets share one stream, not independent trials
primary: REFLEX at period10 must have mean RMSE<=1.02 and mean P90<=1.05 times GRAPE at period5 in all four dataset-delay conditions. Reduction about50% in requested measurements. Report if GRAPE period10 also passes; then savings are not attributable to REFLEX.
secondary: Absolute-error exceedance threshold =95th percentile of all phase predictions from GRAPE period5 on valid+test at each dataset and delay, fixed before evaluation. Report relative reduction in exceedance rate and absolute percentage-point difference. This is a prediction-error proxy, not a physical manufacturing specification or defect rate.
uncertainty: Paired circular block bootstrap50samples5000replicates; noninferiority supported only if upper95% interval below both margins. These intervals do not remove model-selection/reuse bias.
limits: No maintenance-event labels, real elapsed metrology latency, wafer cost, yield, or factory productivity observed; scenario calculator must label all such inputs as assumptions.
